actual.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Fire in the Desert
actual.descripcion: Fire in the Desert | Albuquerque, N.M., mail carrier Marilyn Gandert disappears for days and no one knows where she has gone; when her body is found in the desert, detectives must find the murderer, and they only have a few witnesses beyond Marilyn's family members.

siguiente.titulo: The Murder Tapes • I Did It
siguiente.descripcion: I Did It | Michelle Kinney is found murdered in her apartment in Dubuque, Iowa, puzzling her neighbors; local detectives unearth a haunting truth, leading to a shocking confession from an unlikely murderer.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Scene of the Crime
lista.descripcion: Scene of the Crime | When Brad McGarry is discovered murdered in his Ohio basement, residents in this sleepy coal mining town are left in shock; detectives suspect robbery until a friend comes forward and points them in the direction of someone whom they least expected.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Jane Doe
lista.descripcion: Jane Doe | Judith Therianos is a free spirit who wants to see the good in everyone; after her body is found in a wooded area, detectives unearth video surveillance that shows her alone and unaware of the danger she faces moments before her life is cut short.

lista.titulo: The Murder Tapes • Frenzy
lista.descripcion: Frenzy | After coin collector Billy Shuler is found murdered, the case slowly unravels until someone comes forward to identify his killer.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • Too Much Video
lista.descripcion: Too Much Video | In 2010, three men are murdered in a convenience store in Minneapolis's Somali community; the store's CCTV system uncovers evidence of a robbery gone wrong; footage from cameras around the city could offer clues to the killer's identity.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • Room 48
lista.descripcion: Room 48 | In 2018, three women held hostage in a motel room by armed men face a night of terror that leaves 19-year-old Amber Meadows lying dead in the bathroom; detectives must follow a trail of surveillance footage to find out who pulled the trigger.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • Fallen Star
lista.descripcion: Fallen Star | In 2021, talented high school football star KJ Taylor is killed during a drive-by shooting outside a West Virginia convenience store; CCTV helps detectives follow the trail of the truck spotted stalking KJ's friends leading up to the shooting.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • The Man in the Cowboy Hat
lista.descripcion: The Man in the Cowboy Hat | In 2016, in Kamloops, Canada, a motel cleaner finds the body of an unidentified woman in one of the rooms; detectives turn to surveillance cameras to track a mysterious suspect in a cowboy hat, leading to a desperate manhunt across Canada.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • The Big Guy
lista.descripcion: The Big Guy | On Valentine's Day, police discover Demetrius Graves fatally stabbed on the street; two days later, Bonnie Ross turns up dead at home; a trail of CCTV evidence uncovers that these two very different people share one fateful connection.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • The Hand-Off
lista.descripcion: The Hand-Off | In 2018, a killer shoots 33-year-old restaurant worker Joshua Webb outside an apartment block in Beckley, W.V.; to solve the murder and identify the culprit, police must unravel a web of lies by following a trail of security footage.

lista.titulo: See No Evil • Shattered Dreams
lista.descripcion: Shattered Dreams | In a home in downtown Baltimore, a man finds 24-year-old father and youth worker Dion Smith executed with a shotgun. The other residents are cagey, but a suspicious visitor is singled out thanks to telling CCTV outside the victim's door.

lista.titulo: A Body in the Basement • Collecting Trophies
lista.descripcion: Collecting Trophies | In the fall of 2003 in Hammond, Indiana, a string of disappearances leads detectives to a seemingly ordinary trophy shop worker, and a horrific discovery in his basement reveals him to be a sadistic serial killer who has been preying on the town's teens.

lista.titulo: Homicide Hunter: American Detective • Man's Best Friend
lista.descripcion: Man's Best Friend | A murder victim's lost dog becomes the key clue in solving her murder.

lista.titulo: Killer Confessions: Case Files of a Texas Ranger • A Monster's Game Plan
lista.descripcion: A Monster's Game Plan | A robbery turns into an abduction; surveillance leads the law to a suspect who won't give up the victim's location; Holland works the suspect for hours, racing to find her before time runs out.

lista.descripcion: Dangerous Decisions | An angry driver chases after another car; a disgruntled neighbor takes things too far; a brazen gunman threatens another driver; a biker hangs on for dear life.

lista.descripcion: Knockout Punch | A man points a gun at a young woman after she allegedly cuts him off; a fender-bender leads to a knockout; kids are at risk when their parents take things too far on the road; some international tourists witness a roadside brawl.

lista.titulo: Road Rage • Motor Madness
lista.descripcion: Motor Madness | A motorcycle group ride becomes dangerous; a light collision leads to a confrontation with a knife-wielding man; semi-truck drivers come face-to-face with road-raging motorists; a man is pursued and challenged by an overly aggressive driver.

lista.titulo: 48 Hours on ID • The Menendez Brothers' Fight for Freedom
lista.descripcion: The Menendez Brothers' Fight for Freedom | After spending nearly 34 years behind bars for gunning down their parents in 1989, Lyle and Erik Menendez await a judge's decision on whether new evidence can support their claim that they killed in self-defense.

lista.titulo: 48 Hours on ID • Jade Janks and the Secret Photos
lista.descripcion: Jade Janks and the Secret Photos | Police found Tom Merriman's body in his driveway under a pile of trash and arrested his stepdaughter, Jade Janks; she claims she found him dead in her car, panicked and hid the body but didn't kill him.

lista.titulo: 48 Hours • The Troubled Case Against Jane Dorotik
lista.descripcion: The Troubled Case Against Jane Dorotik | A woman convicted of murdering her husband discovers problems with evidence used against her at trial after nearly two decades in prison.
